# Markups

> Free, open-source, browser Markdown editor with Monaco editing and live preview. No signup.

- [Editor](https://markups.dev/)
- [Product overview](https://markups.dev/landing)
- [Source / MIT license](https://github.com/Nir-Bhay/markups)
- [Privacy policy](https://markups.dev/privacy-policy)
- [Online Markdown editor guide](https://markups.dev/seo/online-markdown-editor)
- [Markdown to PDF (image-based)](https://markups.dev/seo/markdown-to-pdf)
- [Markdown to HTML](https://markups.dev/seo/markdown-to-html)
- [Live preview](https://markups.dev/seo/markdown-live-preview-editor)
- [Cheatsheet](https://markups.dev/seo/cheatsheet)
- [Mermaid examples](https://markups.dev/seo/examples/mermaid)
- [KaTeX math examples](https://markups.dev/seo/examples/math)
- [PDF tutorial](https://markups.dev/seo/tutorials/markdown-to-pdf)

## Important limitations
PDF export is image-based, not searchable/selectable text. Word-compatible .doc is not native .docx. Normal writing uses browser storage; optional AI features can send user-selected text to model providers.
